profile.headline: Software Engineer II at American Water
profile.summary:
Obtained B.A in Computer Science at Rutgers University Camden. I hold an AWS Certified Developer Associate Certification. Experience in creating and working on big data Python applications. Experience creating and working on projects with Django, CSS, Javascript, HTML, and RESTful APIs involved. Some older projects that I created can be found on my github.
https://github.com/regulardude400

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Managing AWS infrastructures and providing support across internal teams to resolve any roadblocks.

positions.title: Triage Engineer
positions.description: Worked as a contractor for Comcast in the Triage Engineer department.

positions.title: Level 1 Tech Support
positions.description:
•	Must use great verbal communication and have problem solving analytical skills.
•	To resolve issues in the most reliable and accurate way as possible. 
•	Responsible for taking inbound calls and assisting clients on product issues.
•	Train clients on new functions and software capabilities.
•	Opening, noting, and completing client tickets with the expectancy of great service.

positions.title: Help Desk Consultant
Crew Member
positions.description:
Served over 5,000 sandwiches to customers and made sure the kitchen was in compliance with food safety laws.

Taught 12 fellow crew members to successfully decrease our average service time from 90 seconds to 50 seconds.
